newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 23.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on April 23:
NEW YORK - The Dow Jones industrial average jumped 173.38 points in its second-largest one-day gain.
WASHINGTON - Drained by the Haft family's battles, Dart Group Inc's real value may be found by selling its various retail chains, some analysts and investors say.
WASHINGTON - The former head of a defunct computer services company in McLean settled a SEC complaint that alleged he illegally hid campaign contributions to members of Congress.

WASHINGTON - American Suzuki Motor Corp. presented what it called "important new evidence" that Consumer Reports magazine faked a 1988 rollover test that killed a key product and cost the company hundreds of millions of dollars in lost sales.

WASHINGTON - Blaming a competitor for a recent decline in its stock price, Snyder Communications Inc of Bethesda said it will speed up release of its first-quarter earnings report by four days in an effort to staunch the slide.
